name: F.E.A.R. Platinum
description: F.E.A.R. Platinum is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter and horror game.

gog.store_details: This bundles F.E.A.R. with its Extraction Point and Perseus Mandate expansions in one install, each with its own exe.
gog.patches: The English version of Extraction Point loses some radio voices when hardware sound is on, and the unofficial 'F.E.A.R. Extraction Point EAX Fix' brings them back (per PCGamingWiki).

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX effects
audio_settings.reason: F.E.A.R. ships with its hardware sound and EAX options off, so it plays with no EAX reverb.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX effects in Extraction Point
audio_settings.reason: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point ships with its hardware sound and EAX options off, so it plays with no EAX reverb.
